mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_events ( event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, schema_version, event_version, payload, trace_id, status ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{schemaVersion}, #{eventVersion}, #{payload}, #{traceId}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, schema_version, event_version, payload, trace_id, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, last_error_message, claimed_by, claimed_until, created_at, published_at FROM outbox_events WHERE event_id = #{eventId} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id, o.event_id, o.aggregate_type, o.aggregate_id, o.event_type, o.schema_version, o.event_version, o.payload, o.trace_id, o.status, o.retry_count, o.next_retry_at, o.last_error_message, o.claimed_by, o.claimed_until, o.created_at, o.published_at FROM outbox_events o WHERE ( ( o.status = 'PENDING' AND ( o.next_retry_at IS NULL OR o.next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ) OR ( o.status = 'PROCESSING' AND o.claimed_until IS NOT NULL AND o.claimed_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outbox_events previous WHERE previous.aggregate_type = o.aggregate_type AND previous.aggregate_id = o.aggregate_id AND previous.event_version < o.event_version AND previous.status != 'PUBLISHED' ) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PROCESSING', claimed_by = #{workerId}, claimed_until = TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ), next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) )

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, last_error_message = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{workerId} AND claimed_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE outbox_events SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = TIMESTAMPADD( SECOND, #{retryDelaySeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ), last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, claimed_by = NULL, claimed_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claimed_by = #{workerId} AND claimed_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
